verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Rippling IT automations: dynamic access rules, custom workflows, and device lifecycle automation. Nothing in the pack shows version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. API version pinning via the `Rippling-Api-Version` header concerns the REST API contract, not automation versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
